alert_dialog@already_open.description: Alert shown when the context menu item is used on the image or video already open in the viewer.
alert_dialog@already_open.message: This image or video is already open in SwiftView.

confirm_dialog@reload_page.description: Confirm dialog shown when the page was opened before the extension was installed, updated or re-enabled, so it has to be reloaded before an image or a video can be opened.
confirm_dialog@reload_page.message: SwiftView can't open images or videos on this page until it's reloaded. Reload now?

context_menu@allow_file_access.description: Context menu item shown on images and videos in local files while the extension isn't allowed to access file URLs. Opens the extension's page in the browser, where the access is allowed.
context_menu@allow_file_access.message: Allow SwiftView access to file URLs

context_menu@not_available_on_page.description: Disabled context menu item shown on pages where the extension can't run, such as the browser's own pages.
context_menu@not_available_on_page.message: SwiftView isn't available on this page

context_menu@open_with_swiftview.description: Context menu item shown on images and videos. Opens the image or video in the viewer.

extension@description.description: Extension description in the Chrome Web Store and on the extensions page. At most 132 characters.
extension@description.message: Opens images and videos from the context menu in a viewer over the page, picking a larger version when the page has one.

extension@name.description: Extension name in the Chrome Web Store and on the extensions page.

options_video@autoplay.description: Checkbox on the options page. When checked, a video starts playing as soon as it opens in the viewer.

options_video@loop.description: Checkbox on the options page. When checked, a video opened in the viewer starts again from the beginning when it ends.

options_video@muted.description: Checkbox on the options page. When checked, a video opens in the viewer without sound.

options_video@title.description: Heading of the group of video options on the options page.

viewer_toolbar@close.description: Tooltip of the button in the viewer's toolbar that closes the viewer.

viewer_toolbar@flip_horizontal.description: Tooltip of the button in the viewer's toolbar that mirrors the image left to right.

viewer_toolbar@flip_vertical.description: Tooltip of the button in the viewer's toolbar that mirrors the image top to bottom.

viewer_toolbar@rotate_left.description: Tooltip of the button in the viewer's toolbar that rotates the image 90 degrees counterclockwise.

viewer_toolbar@rotate_right.description: Tooltip of the button in the viewer's toolbar that rotates the image 90 degrees clockwise.

viewer_toolbar@toggle_zoom.description: Tooltip of the button in the viewer's toolbar that shows the zoom percentage. Switches the image between fitting the screen and its actual size (100%).

viewer@load_error.description: Shown in the viewer when it has nothing to show: every image or video it tried failed to load, or it had nothing to try.
viewer@load_error.message: Couldn't open the image or video
